target.title: policy: preview review-required gateway repairs
target.body:
## Summary  Stacked on #99731 / #99720 / #99700 / #99690 / #99686 / #99121.  Adds review-required `doctor --fix` previews for Gateway policy findings that should not be auto-mutated:  - `policy/gateway-non-loopback-bind`: previews setting `gateway.bind=loopback` for both `gateway.bind` and `gateway.customBindHost` non-loopback findings. - `policy/gateway-node-command-denied`: previews appending the missing command to `gateway.nodes.denyCommands`.  The policy repair handler returns `status: skipped`, leaves config unchanged, and emits preview text through `changes`, `warnings`, and structured config `effects`. The structured repair flow now preserves skipped split-repair `changes` without counting the check as repaired, so review-required previews appear in the same aggregate repair output as automatic repair previews.  ## Policy syntax covered  ```jsonc {   "gateway": {     "exposure": { "allowNonLoopbackBind": false },     "nodes": { "denyCommands": ["system.run"] }   } } ```  ## Evidence collected / findings  - `gateway.bind="lan"` with `allowNonLoopbackBind=false` produces `policy/gateway-non-loopback-bind` and a review-required `gateway.bind=loopback` preview. - `gateway.bind="custom"` plus non-loopback `gateway.customBindHost` produces the same preview. - Policy `gateway.nodes.denyCommands=["system.run"]` with config missing `system.run` produces `policy/gateway-node-command-denied` and a review-required append preview. - All cases keep the original OpenClaw config unchanged and leave the finding present until a reviewed config change is applied. - Skipped split repairs now preserve preview `changes` in the aggregate repair result while keeping `checksRepaired=0` and skipping validation.  ## Validation  - `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/flows/doctor-repair-flow.test.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/register.test.ts --reporter=dot` (10 core repair-flow tests + 293 policy doctor tests passed) - `pnpm lint:extensions` - `node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs src/flows/doctor-repair-flow.ts src/flows/doctor-repair-flow.test.ts` - `pnpm tsgo:extensions` - `git diff --check` - `codex review --base origin/policy-doctor-gateway-http-repairs`: no actionable correctness issues.  ## Notes  - `pnpm tsgo:core` is locally blocked by unrelated untracked `src/oc-path/` files in this worktree (`hasWildcard` / `JsonlLine` unused-symbol errors). Those files are not part of this branch/PR. - Broad `pnpm lint:core` timed out locally; targeted oxlint for the touched core repair-flow files passed.## Real behavior proofBehavior or issue addressed:Review-required Gateway policy repairs now surface skipped preview changes for non-loopback bind and missing node deny-command findings without mutating config or counting the checks as repaired.Real environment tested:Windows PowerShell in `C:\src\openclaw-fork` on the restacked policy series, top head `7aebf26a24`. This is a source-harness proof; it does not start a packaged OpenClaw binary or make live LLM calls.Exact steps or command run after this patch:1. `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/policy/src/doctor/metadata.test.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/register.test.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/strictness.test.ts src/flows/doctor-repair-flow.test.ts --reporter=dot`2. `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs test/scripts/plugin-sdk-surface-report.test.ts --reporter=dot`3. `pnpm tsgo:extensions`4. `pnpm lint:extensions`5. `git diff --check`
6. `node --import tsx scripts/check-policy-config-coverage.ts --check --json`Evidence after fix:The focused policy/core/CLI/tooling Vitest run passed 10 core repair-flow tests, 7 SDK surface tooling tests, 13 policy CLI tests, and 334 policy doctor/doctor-lint tests, including gateway bind preview, custom bind preview, gateway node command preview, and split-repair skipped-change aggregation coverage. `tsgo:extensions`, `lint:extensions`, `git diff --check`, and `node --import tsx scripts/check-policy-config-coverage.ts --check --json` all exited 0.Observed result after fix:Review-required repairs return `status: skipped`, keep config unchanged, preserve preview `changes`/effects in aggregate repair output, keep `checksRepaired=0`, and skip validation for those checks.What was not tested:No packaged CLI smoke, live provider run, or live LLM call was run for this source-harness proof.
